reports.title: Zillow Group Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results

lines: We are on track for Preferred to represent more than 75% of connections by year-end, and we expect to reach 100% in the first half of 2027.

From a standing start a few years ago, we now expect the combination of Zillow Showcase℠, listing media, and sellers transacting with our agent partners to contribute more than $300 million to our 2026 revenue.
We expect that 100% of connections will be serviced by Preferred partners in the first half of 2027.
